verses.12:30: ۞وَقَالَ نِسۡوَةࣱ فِي ٱلۡمَدِينَةِ ٱمۡرَأَتُ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ تُرَٰوِدُ فَتَىٰهَا عَن نَّفۡسِهِۦۖ قَدۡ شَغَفَهَا حُبًّاۖ إِنَّا لَنَرَىٰهَا فِي ضَلَٰلࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏

meaning: The root "shaghaf" (شغف) describes intense love or passion that deeply penetrates one's heart, like reaching the pericardium. It implies being smitten or having one's heart rent by love.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
